svg.title: Strata on Google Cloud: architecture
svg.desc: Go constructs are synthesized into a template, submitted to the Strata API on Cloud Run, planned into a change set and executed as an operation by workers that call Google Cloud REST APIs, with state in Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL.
svg.text: Strata — CloudFormation-style deployment engine on Google Cloud
Go constructs ─synth▶ template.json ─▶ Strata API ─▶ change set (plan) ─▶ operation ─▶ GCP REST APIs · state in Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL
strata-server (distroless, non-root) · min 1 instance · always-on CPU · N instances share one queue
ID-token auth · caller allowlist · audit log
lease + heartbeat · fencing token per claim
via Cloud SQL connector (unix socket) · backups + PITR
APIs · Artifact Registry · engine SA + roles · Cloud SQL · Secret Manager · Cloud Run (private)
Re-runnable. Then deploy/cloudbuild.yaml or the CI deploy job rolls out new revisions.
retries · LRO polling · IAM etag RMW
no client SDKs — stdlib HTTP, one binary
② HTTPS + Google ID token → API
